question: Which guest scalar supplies the current displayed game year, and how is it updated from the turn number?

currentEvidence.method: foreground read-only Ghidra string, reference, and function queries followed by narrow generated-code corroboration
currentEvidence.qualification: Static evidence establishes the converter, update flow, comparisons, and debug-format arguments. The default-off runtime probe matched the visible 1025 AD date at turn 61 and the visible 1050 AD date at turn 62.

calendar.converterResult: Starting at -4000, each positive turn advances by 100 while the year is negative, 50 while below 1000, 25 while below 1700, 10 while below 1900, 5 while below 1950, and 2 thereafter.
calendar.updateFlow: At0x82D1EC3C..0x82D1EC50 the transition loads current turn, adds1, stores low32, passes that exact value to0x82CEFA20 and stores low32 year at0x8312B8E0. Initialization has converter-derived paths; selected deserialization separately requests saved year and turn, so recomputation on every load is not inferred.
calendar.presentationCorroboration: 0x82E08CC8 passes 0x8312B8DC and 0x8312B8E0 as integer arguments to a diagnostic that formats pre-collection memory and RSX measurements followed by turn and year. The recorded format text is 61 UTF-8 bytes excluding terminator, SHA-256 692CEA47C800DFCABD6EB5C66D3B785AAE19A2E0FD51E8E19B3934EF07B80FE7; its original encoding is not established.
calendar.eventYearConsumer: Follow-on packet calendar-event-year-consumer proves that complete function 0x82DF9FD0 compares object field +0x444 with 0x8312B8E0 and immediately returns 1 when the years differ.
calendar.formatBoundary: Complete0x82CF3920..0x82CF39B0 tests signed input r4 against zero, requests negative/positive magnitude formatting through0x82E6A430 or selects a separate zero pointer, then requests0x821B2AD8. The positive arm has no local2100 clamp or year-indexed table. Descendant formatting/string allocation, main-HUD ownership and final wording remain unproved.

runtimeProbe.result: On 2026-08-21 the owner observed Americans in the Medieval Era at 1025 AD; the probe reported civilization 7, era 1, turn 61, and year 1025. After one turn the owner observed 1050 AD; the probe reported turn 62 and year 1050.

guards: Do not derive the displayed year independently from era; era and year are separate guest values.
Publish the calendar scalars only when the corresponding guest reads and player-state gate are valid.
Do not treat the retail debug formatter as runtime observation of a rendered UI string.
Do not assume AD wording for year zero until the owner-visible presentation is checked.
No completed display, save/load, peer agreement or arbitrary-turn correctness beyond2100 is established by late-calendar arithmetic alone.
conclusion: Version 1.3 maintains the current turn at 0x8312B8DC and the visible calendar year at 0x8312B8E0. Static initialization and transition evidence is confirmed by the owner-observed 1025 AD to 1050 AD turn transition.
